verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's REST API/SDKs expose most core tax-compliance actions—nexus lookup, registrations, filings, exemptions, transaction sync, tax estimation, product categorization—that mirror the platform's main UI workflows, and it ships 5 official SDKs plus an MCP server for developer docs access. However there is no explicit documentation claiming full UI/API parity, no accessible OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404s), and management-type UI features (account/user settings, dashboard reporting, filing status changes) are not evidenced via API. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement, public OpenAPI spec, evidence covering all UI-only settings/admin functions.
